instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph, shot at eye-level with a medium scale and shallow depth of field. The scene is set indoors against a plain white background. In the foreground, out-of-focus purple wildflowers frame three women sitting closely on the floor. On the left, the curly-haired woman in a white shirt (R1) leans back against the straight-haired woman in a white sleeveless top (R2) in the center, who clasps R1's arm. On the right, the curly-haired woman in a black tank top (R3) sits behind R2, resting her hand on R2's shoulder. All three look forward with soft, calm expressions. Bright, even studio lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the neutral tones and blue denim.
